challengers.name: Ranking freshness
challengers.sole_change: Set both skips to zero; preserve included lengths, percentile reference universe, transforms and weights.

challengers.name: Formation length
challengers.sole_change: Change included lengths only, retaining Champion skips.

challengers.preserve: Ages5-29 only; profit top-six two closes and age30+ ordinary top-six one close unchanged.

challengers.name: Independent peak-gain retention
challengers.sole_change: From age >=5, latch activation once observed completed-close peak gain>=12%; queue sale when current gain<=50% of peak gain, independent of rank, including at/below basis.
challengers.peak_basis: Completed-close peak since entry and actual source cost basis, matching P50 diagnostic; not the Champion intraday peak.
challengers.age_scope: No new age30 cutoff; all other exit rules retain source priority.
